## Recurrence Hotspots
- **Trust-boundary validation at the periphery** — now 8 PR-2 threads tracing to the same root: trusting whatever a boundary handed back. GPS truthiness, duplicates naming, `loadSettings` no validation, fade-duration `0`-as-falsy, candidate path dedupe (cycle 7), and the PR-1 `"type": 42` symptom. **Suggestion:** when reading from any external source (localStorage, IPC, EXIF, user input, file system, or cross-layer arguments from another part of the codebase), write the per-field type/range guard AND the dedup/normalize step in the same commit as the read.
- **Mid-scan client-state mutation** — 4 of the 12 error-handling actioned items concern UI state changing while a sidecar process is running. Different entry points, same class of bug surfaced across PR-2 cycles 4 and 6. **Suggestion:** when adding any "running" state to a client-side action, audit every code path that calls `reset()` or mutates session-affecting state — disable both the trigger AND guard the handler.
- **Gemini repeated re-raises** — temp-file collision raised 3 times across cycles 2/5/6, Windows path split raised 2 times across cycles 2/6. Both have stable, documented dismissals (file never written; macOS-only per PRD NFR6). **Suggestion:** future cycles can dismiss immediately if Gemini surfaces these again without new context.
